After 120 ms without another edit, commit only the latest text in that burst; later bursts must also commit. A pending accepted edit must be in the store before close or open returns, including when navigation selects another document. Keep the edit bound to its document. Retire the departing save badge before its save can notify subscribers. A save integration may navigate synchronously; a navigation request started inside that callback takes precedence over the earlier request. Preserve synchronous public interfaces.
